items.title: Adolphe Alexander Interview, 1961-03-08
items.q: I remember, too, one time when you made those records with Bunk Johnson, remember, in George Lewis' back. Yeah, yeah, yeah, I played Bartholomew, yeah.

ctx.x: Clarence Dersdun, that's right. No, there's no way to do it. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. And they're taking out. And Pierron used to get the work. Pierron used to get the work at that time. I used to play at the, at Freshina out there, Justin Parra. We played out there with Clarence Dersdun. And played there a while. And after that, uh, I came, uh, uh, things was getting bad. Things was bad then. Things was critical around here. Things was critical around here. And I always got on the Dub Pier. I got on the Dub Pier band.…

I remember when you were at Celestine the last time. Yeah, I took a stroke. I remember, too, one time when you made those records with Bunk Johnson, remember, in George Lewis' back. Yeah, yeah, yeah, I played Bartholomew, yeah. Old Man Barbaran and all.
Yeah, I met y'all in New York at that time.
